node.statement: Fibrewise inverse, distortion, and regularity: on the tangent image, omega_U(Z)=(L_U^{-1}Z)^par is inverse to A maps-to L_U(A+Dg_U(0)A). The estimates from the witness step and ||Dg_U(0)|| <= C0*epsilon_r give norms of omega_U and its inverse at most 1+C_ch*epsilon_r; the displayed omega is a global C^1 bundle trivialization.
